unit.why: A single anecdote about the Yehudi of Przysucha: his sick child is healed after his wife sells everything, including the windows, and gives it to the poor.

stories.start_quote: עו"ש מן היהודי זצ״ל פ״א היה
stories.summary_en: When the Yehudi's child was gravely ill, he told his wife the child would recover only if she sold everything in the house and gave it to the poor; when that was not enough he had her sell even the windows, and the child recovered.

quotes: היה ילד שלו חולה מאוד ובאה הרבנית
tags.why: the tzaddik's child and his wife are the characters

quotes: ובאה הרבנית וצעקה לפניו שיראה שיתרפא הילד
tags.why: the rebbetzin pleads and carries out the instructions

quotes: ויהא הבית ריק ותתן לעניים ואז יתרפא
tags.why: the cure is giving everything to the poor

quotes: ועשתה כך והילד עוד לא נתרפא
tags.why: the first remedy does not yet work

quotes: שתמכור גם את החלונות ועשתה כך ונתרפא הילד
tags.why: the recovery follows from the ordered act
an exchange between the tzaddik and his wife

quotes: שתמכור כל מה שיש לך בבית ויהא הבית ריק
